notes: VAT 12.5% since 1 Aug 2025 (VAT (Budget Amendment) Act 2025 substituted 12.5% for 15% in s.15(1) of the VAT Act 1991). Bullion coded 12.5: the FRCS text of the Act was searched in full - the word gold appears nowhere, including the exempt (First) and zero-rated (Second) schedules. Import duty 5% fiscal duty on all HS 7108 lines (Customs Tariff Act Sch. 2, 2021), excise Free. Silver duty not coded.
